metadata.title: छठी अनुसूचि क्षेत्र में राज्यपाल का रोल | Governor's role in sixth schedule areas | TTADC
metadata.description:
On Friday, a delegation headed by Purna Chandra Jamatia, the Chief Executive Member of TTAADC (Tripura Tribal Areas Autonomous District Council), convened a meeting with Governor Indrasena Reddy Nallu at Raj Bhavan in Agartala. The primary agenda of the meeting was to seek the Governor's assent for 24 Bills, encompassing crucial matters such as the recognition of all indigenous customary laws.

The delegation, which included members of TTAADC, was representative of the diverse perspectives and concerns within the autonomous district. Notably, Kamal Koloi, one of the prominent members, actively participated in the discussions during the meeting.

To gain a comprehensive understanding of the intricacies surrounding the Bills and the implications for indigenous communities, Main Bhi Bharat engaged in a conversation with Kamal Koloi. His insights shed light on the broader context of the proposed legislation and its potential impact on the indigenous customary laws in the region.
